environment.description: Same Step Functions Activity Worker deployed on Ubuntu 22.04 EKS node with containerd 1.7. Pod runs with a custom AppArmor profile 'k8s-sfn-worker' loaded via annotations (container.apparmor.security.beta.kubernetes.io/worker=localhost/k8s-sfn-worker). The profile specifies: deny /etc/** w, deny /proc/*/mem w, deny /sys/** w, owner /tmp/workflow/** rw, deny /tmp/** w (non-owner), and critically includes 'file /tmp/workflow/[a-f0-9]{{8}}_state.json rw' with an explicit deny on path components containing '..' or symlink traversal. The profile was generated via aa-genprof during a 72-hour observation window and includes network restrictions (allow tcp bind 8089, deny tcp connect ** except 169.254.169.254:80). Signal handling is unrestricted within the container PID namespace but file writes outside the /tmp/workflow/[task-id-pattern] glob are denied at the kernel LSM layer regardless of race timing.
